t: Ravelry: Pinwheel Scrap Blanket pattern by Knitting Expat Designs
s: April 4, 2021 - I travel quite frequently and I am always sad that I can’t take my mitered square blanket with me, as it is too large to travel with. So I wanted to come up with a modular blanket that wouldn’t feel overwhelming to seam together at the end. I had recently finished a pair of cushions using a pinwheel construction method and really liked this idea for a blanket, and so the idea was born.
